meta.title: Vendor sees the Best Offer banner and revises line items within the window
gaps: Revise only the applicable line items while leaving other line items unchanged
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Revise only the applicable line items while leaving other line items unchanged

steps.note: Open the prepared vendor-side event state where the Best Offer request has already been sent.
Open the event's pricing round as the participating vendor.
Verify that the vendor sees the Best Offer request banner or notification.
Submit the vendor's revised quote during the available window; the default value is used because the case specifies no revision amount.
Verify that the revised quote was accepted and the vendor round is shown as Submitted.
